rules: Rows are not independently verified apparition nights.
Evening and following dawn may be one vigil; repeated phases are not new nights.
Publication date, event date, duration and time of last recurrence are separate fields.
A source reporting lights is not automatically a recognizable-figure report.
Roughly 90 appearances is not a reconstructed 90-entry primary calendar.
Per-night power-cutoff, viewing geometry and measured illumination are not established by this chronology.
